findings.evidence: `IntegralCurve.lean:149-166,209-213` and `Exponential/Basic.lean:54-64` require only complete space, minimum smoothness three, manifold, T2, and boundarylessness; `Adjoint/Basic.lean:273-287` likewise defines `tangentAd` with `CompleteSpace E`. The PR instead imposes finite dimensionality and C∞ globally at lines 42-51.
findings.fix: State the two tangent-level theorems under `[CompleteSpace E] [LieGroup I (minSmoothness ℝ 3) G] [IsManifold I 1 G] [T2Space G] [BoundarylessManifold I G]`, and put only `conj_lieExp` in a finite-dimensional C∞ section.
findings.issue: The shared `[FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [LieGroup I ∞ G]` context over-strengthens `conj_mulInvariantIntegralCurve` and `conj_mulInvariantExp`; their proof only uses the complete-space/C³ integral-curve and tangent-adjoint APIs, so the advertised geometric naturality is absent for Banach Lie groups.

summary: The tangent-level naturality theorems are unnecessarily restricted to finite-dimensional smooth Lie groups, excluding the complete C³ setting supported by their underlying APIs.
